title: Infer through the Anthropic strategy with a cassette
narrative: Nubble proves the Anthropic Messages backend is a first-class reason lane without a live model. He starts the CLI host with family pass-through and backend anthropic (cassette from response.json), uses the default one-shot infer universe, runs infer with a short prompt, and verifies completion by matching the cassette text plus inference/cost events and token totals from the recorded usage.
implementation: `UserStoryScenario.environment.backend=anthropic` builds `AnthropicStrategy` + `MemoryAsyncHttpClient` against `response.json` (`/v1/messages`). `cli:infer` / `CliInferRunner` emits `core:inference` with usage and priced `core:cost`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `cassette_infer.yaml`: environment backend anthropic, infer step, complete expects for event_types, text, tokens, cost_units.
